description: Required high-risk product behavior coverage files. This manifest prevents critical visible-action tests from disappearing; it does not claim complete coverage.

requiredFlows.reason: Destructive delete actions must show visible progress.
Uploads must show real progress and explicit conflict choices.
Queued transfer progress, cancel, and retry must remain visible and actionable.
Split pane must remain a native same-storage browsing mode.
Browse, search, view switch, empty, and error states must be covered at screen level.
Opening previews and downloading from FileBrowser must remain covered.
